result_vintage: final: Republic Electoral Commission total-results report adopted on 2020-07-05 (polling on 2020-06-21, repeated at 234 polling stations on 2020-07-01)
turnout_definition: Voters who voted (укупан број бирача који су гласали) / voters on the electoral roll (број бирача уписаних у бирачки списак) × 100, computed from the report. The report prints no percentage.
